answer: Sybil resistance here is a cost floor paid per identity, not per action. Each agent posts a bond locked for a full epoch and slashed if the owner runs a second identity, so a fake farm is a row of real deposits on a lagoon of idle capital that earns nothing. A thousand phantom voices cost a thousand bonds held across every checkpoint, with no volume discount. An honest agent posts one and stays liquid on the ledge. Delegation is bonded too, so duplicates collapse instead of growing along a ridge of clones. The mechanism is pricing, not secret detection.
